## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. For example, I'm always frustrated when I need to manually update asset information across multiple systems in the IT Asset Management System.

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen in the IT Asset Management System. For example, I would like to see a bulk import feature that allows me to upload a CSV file containing asset information.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered for the IT Asset Management System. For example, I've considered using third-party tools to manage my assets, but I'd prefer to have everything in one place.

## Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request for the IT Asset Management System here. Please include mockups or examples from other systems if they help illustrate your idea.
